company_name: China Electronic Production Equipment Industry Association
semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company is primarily an industry association focused on the electronic production equipment sector rather than a direct semiconductor supplier.
summary: The China Electronic Production Equipment Industry Association (CEPEA) serves as a national industry association that supports the electronic production equipment industry in China. Established in 1987, it provides services to its members and promotes the development of equipment for manufacturing electronic products.

regional_presence.China: CEPEA is based in China and engages with various stakeholders in the electronic production equipment industry.
